purpose: Frozen, sha256-pinned evidence artifacts for the CL-16 ROOT CANDIDATE stage — the link that stands BEFORE Phase 1. Phase 1 is keyed by a root; nothing produced a candidate root from a surface. This manifest binds the two sources the owner named for that stage: the candidate-root law (abo-fareed) and the Ibn-Faris root lexicon (maqayis_v2). Evidence binding ONLY. CL-16 remains OPEN.
host_root_note: Artifact paths are pinned as absolute HOST paths — a pin that moves is not a pin. To verify the same frozen artifacts from another mount, set CL16_SOURCE_ROOT explicitly; the sha256 of every artifact is still verified, so a wrong root is a hard ARTIFACT_MISSING, never a quiet substitution.
owner_architecture: لا نَنقل هذه المشاريع داخل Hokom، ولا نغيّر Taaqol. نجعلها مصادر أدلة مجمّدة: نثبت ملفاتها المهمة بالبصمة، ثم يقرأها Hokom عبر وسيط صغير، ويمنع أي ترقية غير مأذونة.
runtime_read_rule: The adapter reads ONLY the pinned artifacts below plus the Phase-1 pinned artifacts (via the Phase-1 adapter), and MUST verify sha256 before use. It performs NO git/network operation and does NOT read any source repository's live state at runtime. A missing artifact or a sha256 mismatch is a hard BLOCK. FAIL-CLOSED: this adapter never degrades to an empty answer on error — contrast MAQAYIS_V2_ADAPTER below, whose own contract is fail-open and is therefore NOT imported.
rank_rule: The chain's rank is the MINIMUM rank across its links, never the maximum. A CANDIDATE link caps the whole chain at CANDIDATE. No link may be read beyond its declared limit.
